text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's scrimmage is an exercise designed to serve as a rehearsal for a real G1 race, with participants even wearing their signature racewear. Opportunities like this don't come often, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Mejiro Ardan's trainer! I just had a look at the track, but it's still all mucky from the rain.
choice_data_list: I was afraid of that…

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: There's a chill in the air too. I'm going to withdraw my Umamusume from this one. Passing up this opportunity hurts, but still…

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: If I remember right… your racer's not the burliest around, is she? I'd err on the side of caution if I were you. …Well, see ya later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Trainer. Did I hear the word "withdraw" just now?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they're worried about you.
Yeah, they're worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see… It's kind of them to look out for my well-being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To race or not to race… Have you come to a decision, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Is it okay for me to make the call?
Is it okay for me to make the call?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …What to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The experience she'd get would be invaluable, and she looked great during the warm-ups. I struggle to think of a reason to stop her from racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then again, if she's putting on a brave face… Just to be sure, I ask Mejiro Ardan how she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll be absolutely fine. As long as I run for this moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I've no doubt that I'll be able to run my very best. I assure you I will.
choice_data_list: Understood… Then, let's run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …And you're sure about this?
choice_data_list: Yes. I trust that the moment is yours, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you very much. In that case, I'll hold nothing back—for I shall entertain no regrets.
choice_data_list: Do your best!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to this race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Mingling in with so many Umamusume dressed in their signature racewear brings back memories…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it, it took quite some time for me to don my signature racewear after becoming race-ready.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Proudly sporting their signature racewear, the competing Umamusume are now entering the starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How beautiful… Thank you for bringing me along, Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Nanny
text_block_list.text: It's my pleasure. But you mustn't forget that you only just got out of the hospital, so no running around, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes… I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That pride, that light… How long must I wait to know their embrace?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I swore to myself that no matter what, I would someday wear such an outfit myself. But it would be a lie to say that I was not envious. And now…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gate opens with a bang. The atmosphere is heavy beneath the overcast sky, but her racewear flutters vividly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Now… I wear this outfit to race!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (You lit the spark. That means this clothing also serves as proof of your faith in me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I wish to prove that I am worthy of it—of that pride, and that light!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Pant… I've, I've lost!
choice_data_list: But you did great! …It sure was muddy out there.
But you did great! …It sure was muddy out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Hehe. It really was. My clothes are filthy but…
choice_data_list: That was your first step toward victory.
That was your first step toward victory.
But?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Hehe. It really was. My clothes are filthy but…
choice_data_list: That was your first step toward victory.
That was your first step toward victory.
But?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …! …Hehehe. I was thinking exactly the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall etch this defeat onto my heart. But I didn't run from the contest, I fought. And I raced in the moment, in the now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This experience will surely fuel my resolve. I will strive even harder. And I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I thank you, for having faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I entrust you… with my future endeavors.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to continue living up to her expectations, and be a trainer worthy of her trust… Today has renewed my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Somehow, I feel… rather refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I might be covered in mud and soaked to the bone… but I managed to keep running. And that's because you had faith in me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer? Moving forward… I think it might be difficult for anyone to stop me.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all next time, too!
Yeah, let's give it our all next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With pleasure!
